how_to_verify_audit_chain: 1. Start compose stack: docker compose up -d postgres flowable
4. Start server: DATABASE_URL=... FLOWABLE_BASE_URL=... node dist/index.js
5. Trigger a task cycle (deploy BPMN, start instance, complete external task via worker API)

6. Verify chain integrity: SELECT seq, row_hash, prev_hash FROM choros.audit_event WHERE tenant_id='<id>' ORDER BY seq — confirm prev_hash[n] = row_hash[n-1], seq=1 has prev_hash=32×0x00 (genesis anchor)
7. Canonical recompute check: rerun canonicalPreimage(row) → SHA-256 → compare to stored row_hash — must match (tamper-detect on any field incl. payload.actorType)
8. Full CI gate (no Flowable needed): npm run ci — 801 tests pass, 4 T-0068 static fitness checks green
how_to_start_lifecycle_bridge: Set environment vars: DATABASE_URL, FLOWABLE_BASE_URL, BRIDGE_TOPICS, BRIDGE_WORKER_ID, BRIDGE_TENANT_ID (or auto-resolved from genesis tenant)
Start via node dist/index.js (startMain composition root wires startLifecycleBridge automatically)

startLifecycleBridge starts: (a) startBridgePollLoop — polls Flowable fetchAndLock per topic, enqueues to pgJobStore; (b) startOutboxDispatcherLoop — drains outbox, delivers to Flowable completeTask/failTask, fires onDispatched=buildAuditOnDispatched → appendAuditEvent per delivery
Without FLOWABLE_BASE_URL: server starts cleanly, bridge degrades to no-op handle (no throw) — safe for non-Flowable environments

key_env_vars.FLOWABLE_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080 (dev default) — required to activate lifecycle bridge loops
key_env_vars.BRIDGE_WORKER_ID: worker identity passed to Flowable fetchAndLock (e.g. 's-ledger')
key_env_vars.BRIDGE_TENANT_ID: UUID of tenant; auto-resolved from Postgres genesis tenant if not set

hash_chain_invariants.dense_chain: prev_hash[n] = row_hash[n-1] for all n>1; no gaps/duplicates within tenant
hash_chain_invariants.canonical_preimage_vocab_1: field order (vocab=1): tenant_id,seq,id,type,actor,subject,scope,via,proposed_by,confirmed_by,payload,occurred_at,prev_hash,vocab_version; encoding: uuid=16B raw BE, bigint=8B BE, smallint=2B BE, text=UTF-8 NULL-sentinel=0xFFFFFFFF≠empty, jsonb=JCS/RFC8785 UTF-8, bytea=raw 32; row_hash=SHA-256(preimage)
hash_chain_invariants.tamper_detection: changing any field (incl. payload.actorType) causes recomputed row_hash to diverge from stored value — detected by chain verifier
hash_chain_invariants.append_only: UPDATE/DELETE on audit_event rejected: choros_app (GRANT=SELECT,INSERT only) + migrator (trigger 006 'append-only'); audit_head in-place tamper rejected by trigger 007 ('seq must advance by exactly +1')
